DXB-01: DXB-01 (urban dense) is expected to require 71 productive courier-hours on its peak day in the 90-day window (30 October 2026, 930 forecast shipments). After rest days, leave, breaks and target utilisation are applied, its 9 existing couriers can supply about 41 hours, a gap of 30 hours on that day. Across the full 90-day horizon this store's requirement stays persistently above its current headcount (structural gap of 5 head-equivalents at the median week), so 1 permanent courier(s) and 4 outsourced courier(s) are recommended to close it. Recruitment for the permanent addition(s) should begin no later than 02 August 2026 given the 45-60 day hiring lead time; this date is already at or before today, so the recommendation is flagged as an immediate/overdue hiring action. In addition, demand volatility adds a temporary peak of about 1 extra head-equivalents above the structural level in the busiest weeks; this is recommended to be covered with short-lead-time outsourced capacity (5-10 day booking) rather than permanent hiring, since it does not persist.
